title: evidence.ledger
description: An append-only record of gate verdicts and their declared provenance. A node may transition verifying -> completed only when its unique current passing entry declares assurance external, or gate_kind human_approval. Currentness is established by append-only relations, not by editing old entries or choosing the latest timestamp. These fields do not establish that the evidence content is adequate or correct. Field names and enum values are locked byte-for-byte per references/state_model.md (evidence.ledger).

relations.description: Optional append-only lifecycle relations. The source entry must appear after and have a strictly later recorded timestamp than the target entry; entries remain immutable observations.

entry_id.description: Unique id of the ledger entry.

node_id.description: The node the verdict is for.

score.description: Finite numeric score for scored gates (0..1), or null for pass/fail gates. YAML non-finite values are rejected by the hand-written validator because JSON Schema numbers cannot express that portability constraint.

artifact_path.description: Path to the evidence artifact this entry attests.

producer_claim_path.description: Legacy compatibility path to a producer claim. It does not establish blindness or independence; new blind reviews use review_context.

review_context.description: Explicit context manifest for a declared blind review; role labels and mtimes do not establish blindness.

recorded.description: When the entry was recorded (ISO-8601 date-time).

assurance.description: Declared verdict provenance only; this does not establish evidence adequacy or correctness.

success_criteria_id.description: Optional citation to loop.plan.success_criteria[].id. R45 checks only that a present citation resolves; resolution does not establish criterion satisfaction or evidence adequacy.

overrides_entry_id.description: Optional entry_id of the exact prior verdict this newer entry overrides. The source entry must appear later and have a strictly later recorded timestamp. For a completed node with an active blind failure, R48 also requires an exact dissent chain.

supersedes.description: entry_id of a prior ledger entry this newer entry corrects/supersedes, or null. The source entry must appear later and have a strictly later recorded timestamp.

status.description: Legacy compatibility field. New append-only entries, and any ledger accepted for completion authority, must keep the immutable observation status 'active'; currentness changes only through newer explicit lifecycle relations (rule R38). Defaults to 'active' when omitted.

superseded_by.description: Deprecated compatibility field. Immutable observations leave it null; use a newer append-only relation from the replacement entry instead.
